sources.label: Patches for Android TV apks
sources.author: ajstrick81
patch_list: Removes ads before and during videos in the Joyn Android TV app. It turns off the app's own "ads enabled" flag, so the player is built without Joyn's Ad SDK. Joyn is geo-restricted, so playback still needs Germany, Austria or Switzerland.
